outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 5439 term, non-anomalous singleton pregnancies with an ultrasound performed between 36 and 38 weeks gestation
finding: A predictive model incorporating maternal, intrapartum, and ultrasound variables demonstrated moderate accuracy in predicting severe adverse neonatal outcomes in term infants.
mod_finding: Method of birth was included as a variable in the final predictive model for severe adverse neonatal outcomes.
